description: A Flutter widget implementation of a login screen optimized for Android TV with DPAD navigation, including focus management and custom styling.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login screen with focus navigation tailored for Android TV.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing focus nodes, controllers, and user interactions for the LoginScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes focus nodes, controllers, and sets the initial focus on the username field.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes controllers and focus nodes to free resources.

methods.name: _requestNext
methods.description: Requests focus for the specified next focus node.

methods.name: _requestPrev
methods.description: Requests focus for the specified previous focus node.

methods.name: _triggerLogin
methods.description: Navigates to the '/home' route upon login action without authentication.

methods.name: _handleDpadTraversal
methods.description: Handles DPAD navigation (up/down/select) for focus movement and triggers login.

methods.name: _tvInputDecoration
methods.description: Builds custom input decoration with focus-aware styles suitable for TV UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the login screen, including focus management and UI layout.
